themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Articles discussing AI agents that can independently perform research tasks, analyze data, and generate insights.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Focuses on AI tools that help developers write, review, debug, and optimize code.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Covers AI-powered tools specifically designed to aid researchers in data analysis, information retrieval, and insight generation.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Articles related to AI applications that condense large amounts of text, such as research papers, meeting transcripts, or articles, into concise summaries.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Discusses the creation and use of artificial user profiles or data for testing, research, or simulation purposes.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Focuses on the study and analysis of AI chatbots, including their behavior, user interactions, and potential impacts.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: Explores how AI is integrated into the design process, from ideation and prototyping to research synthesis and best practice alignment.

themes.name: AI customer insights
themes.description: Covers AI applications used to gather, analyze, and interpret customer data to derive actionable insights for businesses.

themes.name: AI usability testing
themes.description: Articles focusing on AI's role in automating or augmenting the process of testing product usability and user experience.

themes.name: AI design research
themes.description: Examines how AI is used to inform and guide the design process through research and analysis of user needs and preferences.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
